svg.title: Steno and BOCU-1, by language (UDHR, 16-character values)
svg.desc: Bar chart of bytes per character of Steno and BOCU-1 on the 16-character values of the UDHR, per language. The same numbers are in the table UDHR, 16-Char Values, under Size by Language.
svg.text: Steno and BOCU-1, by language (UDHR, 16-character values)
Bytes per character (UTF-16 code units) over all values; smaller is better. Each value encoded on its own.
